# Kalendarz 1.5.0 — Part 2 Beta 1

This cumulative beta includes the accepted Part 1 Beta 3 and adds a compact month layout with content-sized weeks, capped event lanes and accessible overflow. Eight approved themes (104 HEX values), custom palette editing, PINs of 4–16 digits, passwords of 8–64 characters, optional Android strong biometrics and persistent motion controls are included. Dialog and AI panel exits honor speed and reduced motion. The desktop composer now stays disabled until an animated panel releases focus, preserving the first message typed after closing settings.

## Validation

167 unit tests, 14 release-guard tests, 19 Android JVM tests and TypeScript passed. Browser regression covered storage/import/offline behavior, Beta 3 upgrades, palettes, security, motion and responsive calendar views. Both source-commit CI runs passed web and full packaged-desktop tests, including actual GGUF execution. The actual AppImage was extracted and run under Xvfb: views, palettes, event persistence and shutdown passed.

## Update and model setup

Android retains `com.kalendarz.offline.diagnostics`, the existing update certificate and versionCode 10508. Install over Part 1 Beta 3; do not uninstall or clear app data. On Linux, make the AppImage executable and run it with the existing user profile. Both packages omit GGUF weights: retain an installed model or import a compatible GGUF. No model training or weight changes were performed.

## Known limitations

Real Android biometric success/cancellation/unavailability and the actual device update still require testing on POCO; browser bridge simulation and Java compilation do not establish device correctness. Biometrics require Android 11/API 30+ with a strong enrolled biometric; PIN/password remains available. Screen locking does not encrypt application data. Android may ignore system-bar colors; launcher label refresh can be delayed by HyperOS. Details expansion falls back to immediate changes on older engines. Small local models can produce inaccurate answers. AppImage startup was tested under a virtual X server, not on a physical Linux desktop.

This is a Pre-release. Stable Latest remains 1.4.2; PR #20 is not merged.
